verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant inside the Airwallex web app or product UI. AgentOS, the AgentOS MCP server, the CLI and the developer connectors all let external AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) act on an Airwallex account. That is adjacent tooling for third-party agents, not an in-product assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
